items.title: Abbott Laboratories (ABT) Starts VOYAGER CE Trial With New Encantor TAVI System
items.summary: Abbott Laboratories (NYSE:ABT) has launched its software-guided, balloon-expandable Encantor TAVI system for structural heart procedures. The firm has begun the VOYAGER CE clinical trial, enrolling patients in Europe and Australia to assess the Encantor TAVI platform. Encantor is designed to work alongside Abbott's existing Navitor TAVI system, broadening options for treating severe aortic stenosis.
